title: D-094 P-6.0: research record NB-06 for 215-16 Northern Boulevard: street-wall location (ZR 23-431, 35-631(b)), the 23-433 setback trigger at or below the base height, and side yards in R6B - the constraints a placed building must respect
objective: Write evidence record NB-06 from the repository's law captures (and dated live fetches where a capture is missing): street-wall location along each frontage, the 23-433 setback trigger for a building at or below the base height, and R6B side-yard rules, so a later placement step can respect them or state what stays unresolved.
